_comment: Block-level validity cases on a regtest chain. Proof of work is NOT checked (any nonce). Candidate height = parent_height + 1; state = genesis + base_chain[:parent_height]. Genesis is built from the genesis.json fixture with the DRAFT params_hash. Signatures are randomized, so this file is generated once and verified in CI, not regenerated. Only public keys appear; no secret keys were stored. 'reason' is informative. Not covered here: the 720,000 weight limit (see consensus.json weights).
